name: thousandeyes_api_call
description: Call the Cisco ThousandEyes API v7 (read-only). Base https://api.thousandeyes.com; auth (Bearer token) is handled for you. A configured account group is auto-applied as the 'aid' query param. Returns {status_code, data, error, blast_radius}. List responses are an object keyed by resource name (e.g. data['tests']). Core: GET /v7/account-groups, /v7/tests (find testId), /v7/tests/{id}, /v7/agents, /v7/test-results/{testId}/{testType} (network|http-server|page-load|dns-server|bgp), /v7/test-results/{testId}/path-vis (hop-by-hop), /v7/dashboards, /v7/alerts. Method is always GET. Check status_code < 400 before trusting data.

function.name: thousandeyes_api_call
function.description: Call the Cisco ThousandEyes API v7 (read-only). Auth is handled internally.
